definitions.gloss: monthly installment; monthly proration; monthly basis
definitions.explanation: Dividing a total amount into monthly portions, or calculating something on a per-month basis. Commonly used for payments, fees, and accounting.

examples.japanese: {月割|つきわ}りで{支払|しはら}う。
{年会費|ねんかいひ}を{月割|つきわ}り{計算|けいさん}すると、{一|ひと}か{月|げつ}{千円|せんえん}になる。
examples.english: If you prorate the annual membership fee monthly, it comes to 1,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {途中|とちゅう}{入会|にゅうかい}の{場合|ばあい}は、{月割|つきわ}りで{料金|りょうきん}を{精算|せいさん}いたします。
examples.english: In the case of mid-term enrollment, fees will be settled on a prorated monthly basis.

notes:
Composed of {月|つき} (month) and {割|わ}り (division, rate). Used in business, accounting, and subscription contexts to describe breaking annual or total amounts into monthly portions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月割|つきわ}り{計算|けいさん}: monthly proration calculation
- {月割|つきわ}りで{払|はら}う: to pay monthly
- {月割|つきわ}り{料金|りょうきん}: prorated monthly fee
- {月割|つきわ}り{額|がく}: monthly prorated amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {月払|つきばら}い: monthly payment — focuses on the act of paying monthly rather than the calculation
- {分割払|ぶんかつばら}い: installment payment — more general; can be any interval
- {日割|ひわ}り: daily proration — the same concept applied on a daily basis
